decisions.title: Choose staging deployment strategy: remote auto-deploy with GitHub Actions vs local manual deploy
decisions.context: User requested staging environment setup. Two options available: local (docker-compose.staging.yml) or remote (staging.jemavi.co with auto-deploy). Chose remote auto-deploy to ensure CI/CD pipeline validation and maintain staging server in sync with GitHub.
